meta.name: pipeline-wgbs
meta.description: Execute ENCODE Whole Genome Bisulfite Sequencing (WGBS) pipeline from FASTQ to methylation calls. Child of pipeline-guide. Provides Nextflow execution with Docker and cloud deployment. Use when processing WGBS/bisulfite-seq data, calling methylation levels, generating bedMethyl files. Trigger on: WGBS pipeline, bisulfite sequencing, methylation calling, DNA methylation pipeline, bismark, bwa-meth, bedMethyl.
